task: EPMCDME-16072: equal per-member spend-limit split floors to cents (never exceeding the budget), allows $0 shares with a logged warning, exposes zero_limit_member_count on project budget and group category responses with a UI warning banner, and recomputes persisted equal shares when member spend-limit enforcement is toggled on.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: ProjectBudgetService (equal-share allocation, fixed-override split, recompute_equal_shares, zero-share warning), BudgetService (budget/group response data), project budget router (response mapping, zero_limit_member_count), project budget API models, LiteLLM project member runtime sync (resync on enforcement toggle triggers recompute), UI ProjectBudgetsSection (warning banner), UI projectBudget/projectBudgetGroup entity types
component_scope.layers: UI, API, Service, External (LiteLLM enforcement sync)

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Minor: leftover cents stay unallocated by design, and the $0-share case is handled with a warning and a UI banner rather than a block. Both are explicit decisions carried in code and tests; no open gaps visible in the diff.

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: Money arithmetic moved to Decimal with cent floor (ROUND_DOWN) on the enforcement path; enforced $0 shares block those members from spending; recompute_equal_shares rewrites persisted allocations and shared child budgets when enforcement is toggled on (runtime data healing of rows saved under older split rules); fixed-override validation now feeds recompute, which skips budgets whose overrides exceed the total; provider re-sync pushes the new limits to LiteLLM
technical_risk.mitigation: Follows existing allocation and resync patterns in ProjectBudgetService and project_member_runtime_sync; recompute makes no provider calls and is followed by the existing resync loop; dedicated regression suite for small budgets and large member counts; structured warning logs (member_share_below_minimum, member_share_recompute_skipped); additive response field with default 0; OpenAPI baseline updated

key_reasoning.reason: Multi-repo changes with distinct content across 2 repos - scope scored additively. 13 files in total (9 backend, 4 UI): 12 modified and 1 new regression test module, spread over backend src/tests and UI src. Most of the 742+72 inserted lines are tests, so this count overstates the production change.

Full-stack change across 4+ components in separate subsystems: ProjectBudgetService allocation math and the new recompute_equal_shares, BudgetService/router response shaping, API response models, LiteLLM member runtime sync (enforcement toggle path), and the UI budgets section and entity types. No new abstractions, so L rather than XL.

UI + API + Service + the LiteLLM enforcement-provider sync path. No DB schema change or migration. The existing provider integration is touched, not a new one, so there is no integration red-flag bump.

M: spend-limit math on the enforcement path changed (Decimal cent floor, $0 shares allowed). The toggle-on recompute rewrites stored allocations at runtime. Both are contained by existing resync patterns and a dedicated regression suite.
